rationale:
iter-11 CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE (projection-domain BF kernel SIZE / receptive field) toward the iter-20 hard stop -- NOT hr-chasing. Change EXACTLY ONE knob: proj_kernel 5 -> 11 (more than double the PROJECTION-domain bilateral filter spatial support, 5x5 -> 11x11). This is a genuinely NOT-yet-tried axis and the symmetric companion to iter-10: iter-10 widened the IMAGE-domain receptive field (img_kernel 7->13, flat 0.946223, hr 0, confirming the ceiling is NOT an image-domain receptive-field limit); this iter-11 closes the OTHER receptive-field axis by widening the sinogram-domain BF's reach. It adds NO trainable parameters (still exactly 6: proj_n_bf=img_n_bf=1, 3 sigma each). img_kernel reverted 13 -> 7 (CONFIG default) so this is a clean single-knob A/B vs the iter-1 canonical config isolating the projection-kernel-size axis. Everything else held at iter-1 canonical: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, img_n_bf=proj_n_bf=1, all sigmas at Wagner defaults, n_iter=400, lr=5e-3, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=200, val_n=6, seed=1234 (iter-6-confirmed stable).

STATE: CONVERGED to the 6-param structural ceiling. 10 iters all flat at SSIM ~0.9452-0.9470 @1, hr 0 (PSNR ~35.6 dB, ~1 dB BELOW the LD-FBP baseline 36.56 dB): iter-1 0.946237, iter-2 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.945237, iter-3 (img_sr 0.02->0.005) 0.946177, iter-4 (proj_sr 0.02->0.0005) 0.945745, iter-5 (warm_start OFF) 0.945955, iter-6 (seed 42->1234) 0.946157, iter-7 (pretrain_epochs 3->8) 0.946953, iter-8 (n_iter 400->800) 0.946240, iter-9 (lr 5e-3->1e-3) 0.945747, iter-10 (img_kernel 7->13) 0.946223. This matches the documented dd-bf-supervised structural ceiling (capped 0.9502 with the SAME 6 BF params, every scalar flat).

FAILURE MODE (structural, not a tuning miss): the 6-param bilateral cannot beat an already-clean dense-view (2304-angle) FBP -- the half-view N2I information loss (each per-scan fit only ever sees a 1152-angle subset of the scan) exceeds what 6 trainable bilateral params can denoise, so no sigma/depth/warm_start/seed/warm-start-depth/per-scan-step/lr/image-kernel setting clears hr=0. The remaining iters to iter-20 are CEILING DOCUMENTATION (probes that show WHY the ceiling holds), not optimization.

WHY THIS KNOB / NEW AXIS (untried): iter-10 ruled out the IMAGE-domain receptive field (img_kernel 7->13 flat) as the cause of the ceiling, but left the PROJECTION-domain receptive field untested -- proj_kernel has stayed at the CONFIG default 5 in ALL 10 prior iters. The projection-domain BF runs on the sinogram BEFORE the FBP, so its spatial support sets how far the sinogram denoiser can aggregate along the detector/angle axes. This probe asks the sharpest remaining receptive-field question for the projection domain: is the ~0.947 ceiling escapable by a wider sinogram BF window (a 5x5 window too small to span the noise correlation length of the 2304-view sinogram, fixable at the same 6 params), or is it a true 6-PARAM-CAPACITY limit independent of sinogram-domain reach? Widening proj_kernel 5->11 more than doubles the projection-domain receptive field while keeping params at exactly 6, cleanly isolating sinogram-domain receptive field from capacity. Together with iter-10 it bounds the ceiling along BOTH receptive-field axes (image + projection).

EXPECTATION (success condition for a ceiling-confirmation probe): proj_kernel 5->11 is expected to land at essentially the SAME ~0.9462 @1, hr 0. A flat result CONFIRMS the ceiling is a 6-PARAM-CAPACITY limit, NOT a projection-domain receptive-field limit -- widening the sinogram BF's spatial reach does not let 6 trainable params denoise below the already-clean 2304-view FBP, bounding the ceiling along the projection-domain receptive-field axis (the last untested receptive-field axis after iter-10's image-domain result) and ruling out 'projection kernel too small' as the cause. By construction this adds NO trainable capacity, so it cannot escape the ceiling -- it can only document its invariance to the projection-domain BF receptive field. This documents the ~0.947 6-param structural ceiling toward the iter-20 hard stop, not hr-chasing.

Per-image N2I (commit 1f4c3394): short amortized warm-start pre-pass (3 ep x 200 train) then per-scan Adam fit (400 steps) on each val scan's OWN half-angle measurements (GT-free), scored by evaluate_calibrated on the SAME L277 val scenes as every other Mayo method. NOT amortized train-then-forward. Wall <=15 min target: an 11x11 projection BF is modestly slower per step than 5x5 but n_iter/val_n unchanged; iter-1 ran 469s at proj_kernel=5/val_n=6, expect ~520-620s, within the 1h sbatch wall and the <=15 min soft target.
